disclaimer: This site showcases makers and does not process transactions. Please contact the maker directly.
aboutText: Chan Hui is an online market for Hong Kong makers. Wander Sham Shui Po to discover thoughtful handmade work. We do not process transactions. Shop prices apply.
banned: Not permitted: resale or proxy purchases, counterfeit or infringing character goods, tobacco, alcohol, medicines or therapeutic claims, adult products, live animals, weapons.
reportText: Use the report link in a stall panel to contact the site owner.
reportUnset: The report address has not been configured.
step1: ① Hold and drag, or tap the ground to walk.
step2: ② Tap a stall to discover handmade work.
step3: ③ Tap your character to change your look.
name: Brand name
